rationale: Base 035428b6. AD-339 and epic #880 task D1. Five modules join the contracts: archkeel.ir.identity_memo (facts, public), archkeel.ir.dependency_binding (evidence), archkeel.check.contract_tree (observation), archkeel.check.report_filter (workflows) and archkeel.render.page_assets (html). The CLI calls the new archkeel.check.report:run_report_with_observation instead of run_report, so the coupling name list of cli -> check swaps one name for another and keeps its count of 6. The baseline lowers calls_unresolved from 973 to 970. No budget rises, and no rule, component, requires entry or Any permission changes.
